The '''Captain of the Fortitude''' was in command of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] ''[[Fortitude (Valor-class)|Fortitude]]''. The ship was designated for a meeting with the [[Rift Alliance]], a group that threatened secession from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Because of this [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Kyrus]] ordered [[Arrax (Sith)|Arrax]] to sabotage the ship and kill everyone onboard. The Sith killed the captain, disabled the ship's life support and fire control systems, and locked the navigational computer into a collision course with [[Deralia]].<ref name="TOR" />
